title.narrative: Strengthening Moldova¿s national capacities to provide quality protection, education, health services and socio-economic opportunities for Ukrainian refugees

description.narrative: Contract related to: Strengthening Moldova¿s national capacities to provide quality protection, education, health services and socio-economic opportunities for Ukrainian refugees - This 18-month measure aims to strengthen the Republic of Moldova¿s resilience to the crisis situation. It will support national efforts to increase the country¿s cyber- and information security while also providing inclusive assistance to the government and population in managing the refugee influx resulting from the war in Ukraine. In a first component, the measure will assist the establishment of a robust cyber threats monitoring and reaction mechanism (Cyber Security Operation Centre and/or national Computer Emergency Response Team ) under the responsibility of the Deputy Prime Minister for Digitalisation, to help identify possible cyberattacks and enable relevant authorities to launch and coordinate responsive action when necessary. In a second component, the action will support increased cooperation between government authorities, civil society, and the independent media, to increase media-literacy and to respond to disinformation. A third component will provide assistance to government authorities to ensure the inclusive hosting of recent arrivals from Ukraine, with a specific focus on strengthening the resilience of host-communities to mitigate deterioration in access to basic services linked to the refugee influx. This component will be implemented in close coordination with planned humanitarian and development cooperation assistance.

comment.narrative: Output 1.2The new NRMV including government response to other types of abuse and crimesother than trafficking in persons is piloted.

In March 2022 the Moldovan Government approved the program to create and develop a National Referral Mechanism for the Protection and Assistance of Victims of Crimes of the Republic of Moldova for 20222026 NRMV Program which is meant to gradually replace the National Referral System for Assistance of Victims and potential victims of trafficking. The new NRMV managed by MLSP is designed to assist all victims of violent crimes including victims of trafficking and genderbased violence. Since the beginning of the refugee crisis in the Republic of Moldova the MLSP declared that the refugees and thirdcountry nationals TCNs victims of crime can access the support available under the NRMV. With the support of FPI IOM provided technical and expert support to the MLSP to pilot the newly adopted program.
